notes: Product: JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that ships a local indexer + remote inference fallback.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions (sub-50ms for local cached completions, <200ms for remote) and model/version pinning so QA can reproduce completions.
Indexing: indexer runs locally (user machine) and optionally uploads hashed embeddings to private VPC for cross-user search — customer must control retention and residency.
Quote from CTO: "We need deterministic completions for codegen CI checks — pin model and tokenizer versions, and lock quantization profile."
Security: will need SSO/SAML, audit logs for inference requests, KMS integration for model keys, and ability to run Redwood control plane in their VPC.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictable latency and good developer UX; wants recommendations from Redwood Optimize (batching vs caching tradeoffs for IDE workloads).
Integration notes: prefer a lightweight local agent rather than heavy docker images; autopatch of kernel/quantized artifacts behind customer VPC pull is acceptable.
SE notes: test matrix for POC - (1) streaming latency with 1k concurrent dev sessions simulated, (2) fallbacks when private capacity saturated, (3) correctness/regression vs baseline model.
